mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate signals an ongoing monetary tightening cycle that increases the cost of capital for corporations, leading to lower equity valuations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% in a 3-month window, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending power and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 40% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC for UNRATE threshold crossings is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers a sell-off in equities as corporate revenue expectations are revised downward, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST decline in the last month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or the Rank IC for the joint decline signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a period of rising industrial production (INDPRO), the supply chain is improving, which reduces input costs for corporations and boosts profit margins, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 40% of instances when INDPRO rises, or the Rank IC for INDPRO rises is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals persistent inflation that forces the Federal Reserve to accelerate rate hikes, which increases real interest rates and depresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 5.0%, or the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL threshold crossings is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in less than 40% of instances when PAYEMS rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a period of strong consumer demand (as measured by retail sales), the economy is in a late-cycle expansion where corporate earnings are robust, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 40% of instances when RSAFS is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC for RSAFS in late-cycle expansion is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a broad economic slowdown that reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO declines and UNRATE rises in the last month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 40% of instances when INDPRO declines and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.
